names: UCSF Valley Center for Vision -- west building (OCII plan block 33)
summary: A real, standing UCSF building on OCII plan block 33, between 3rd St and Illinois St, west of Illinois St. UCSF's own June 2025 CAC presentation map labels block 33 'VALLEY CENTER FOR VISION (33)', which supports the name. The tracked tower at 490 Illinois St, east of Illinois St, is a separate record also named Valley Center for Vision; that record's identification should be reviewed against the same UCSF map (see open questions). Its footprint here is approximate (see the shape's accuracy caveat).

open_questions: This project already tracks a separate, independently sourced record also named Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois St (the 490/499 Illinois Street record), about 60-100m east of this building, across Illinois St. That record's own 2017 UC Regents source describes a single 12-story tower with a 5-story south wing and a 3-story north wing at 490 Illinois St -- it does not mention a separate west-of-Illinois-St building. Whether this west building is a second wing/annex of the same named facility built later, a distinct building that happens to share the name, or a misidentification of one of the two records, has not been resolved against any primary source -- flagged here rather than silently merged with, or silently treated as unrelated to, the 490 Illinois St record.

2026-09-22, new data point (not a resolution): matching DataSF's business-registration records to this building's shape by location, after the shape was added to the map, shows several registrations -- Buenafe #2, All May See, All May See Foundation, Simon Fung -- whose registered point-location falls inside THIS west building's polygon, but whose own listed street address is '490 Illinois St' (the other, east-of-Illinois-St tower's address), not a west-of-Illinois-St address. This could mean the two buildings genuinely share one administrative/mailing address, or it could simply be a DataSF geocoding artifact (a coarse or shared geocode for a multi-building campus) -- the match is by location only and is never treated as confirmed on its own, so this is logged as a data point for later review, not treated as confirming the relationship either way. Notably, the same matching for the neighboring UCSF Bayfront Medical Building and UCSF Illinois Street Garage records do show addresses consistent with their own already-sourced identities (520 Illinois St and 590 Illinois St respectively), which is corroborating, not contradictory, evidence for those two.

No address, opening date, architect, cost or square footage for this specific west building was found as of 2026-09-22; every fact this project has for 'Valley Center for Vision' construction, cost and massing lives in the 490 Illinois St record instead, and may or may not apply here.

Geometry: this building's east edge (its own real, digitized boundary) sits close to, but not necessarily exactly on, Illinois St's west curb line -- not independently verified against DataSF Building Footprints or an Assessor parcel; see the shape's accuracy caveat.

Added 2026-09-29: UCSF's June 12, 2025 CAC presentation (p.3 map, updated December 2024) labels block 33, between Third St and Illinois St, 'VALLEY CENTER FOR VISION (33)', which supports this record's identification. That reverses the open question above: the separate 490/499 Illinois St record, whose polygon is east of the Illinois St centerline, may be the one that is mislabelled as Valley Center for Vision. The two records have not yet been reconciled; nothing was changed here.
